summary.text: Trojan elder who sat with Priam among the counsellors at the Scaean gates when Helen came to the wall — distinct from Thymoetes the last Athenian king of the Theseid line in Pausanias.

story.text: About Priam and Panthous and Thymoetes and Lampus and Clytius and Hicetaon, scion of Ares, and Ucalegon and Antenor — men of prudence both — sat as elders of the people at the Scaean gates; because of old age had they now ceased from battle, but speakers they were full sweet, like unto cicalas that in a forest sit upon a tree and pour forth their lily voice.
